digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI/CD workflow and Pandoc testing architecture
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay currently runs thousands of conversions on the macOS critical path and consumes at least 184.32 seconds per run
ADR 0095 mandates every conversion assertion use the real Pandoc binary; ADR 0096 must narrowly supersede this requirement only for the test execution boundary
The approved design keeps three representative live corpus bodies in Gerrit Verify with committed golden outputs, while moving complete replay to a dedicated external-integration job
External Integration workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and requires a new pandoc-corpus-replay job matrix with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest runners
Production renderer invariants, pin/provenance probes, platform boundaries, and all assertion classes against committed outputs remain preserved in Verify
